claim.text: To list on the Shopify App Store, an app must be submitted to Shopify's App Approval team.

evidence.quote: When you're ready to distribute your app on the Shopify App Store, you need to submit it to Shopify's App Approval team and make sure it meets all requirements.

summary: Two paths, chosen up front and permanent. A custom app is installed by one organization directly, with no listing and no review, but cannot use Shopify's billing. A public app can be installed on many stores but must pass App Approval and register for the App Store, which has a one-time fee. No review timeline is published.

steps.text: Choose the distribution method first. You cannot change it afterwards.
